attacker.note: Both policies see the same seeded RNG stream per episode, but choose different actions, so the pairing is approximate rather than exact. This is a seeded simulator outcome, not an independent statistical trial: the simulator reward makes repeated attacks easier to detect, which the vector-state DQN can exploit while the tabular state cannot.

caveats: Synthetic holdout data; no live Kubernetes trials were run.
v1.1 raw trials and statistics remain immutable.

defender.note: Holdout samples are seeded perturbations of the committed baseline; they are synthetic and are not v1.1 experimental evidence. All four detectors score the same 30 normal and 30 anomalous windows.
